| [`deposits.term_deposit.DepositTerminatedEarly`](./deposits.term_deposit.DepositTerminatedEarly.md) | The deposit is broken before maturity and settled net of the configured penalty (02 §2.5): NetSettlementAmount = PrincipalReturned + NetAccruedInterest − PenaltyAmount (the accrued NET interest is settled back; only the penalty is forfeited). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): deposit_id is an opaque reference, never depositor identity. |
| [`deposits.term_deposit.InterestPaid`](./deposits.term_deposit.InterestPaid.md) | Interest is paid out — the coarse coupon/advance payout fact (the periodic/coupon variant, vs the single AT_MATURITY flow): NetInterest = GrossInterest − WithholdingTax conserved to the cent. PROMOTED to an integration event per [ADR-IC-017](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-017-integration-event-promotion-criterion.md) §P4 (coarse business fact; GL/accounting, notifications, and reporting react to it). The integration-relevant withholding AMOUNT rides here on withholding_tax_cents — the fine-grained WithholdingApplied/InterestAccrued accrual mechanics stay internal/store-only. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): deposit_id is an opaque reference, never depositor identity. |
| [`loans.personal_loan.LoanDisbursed`](./loans.personal_loan.LoanDisbursed.md) | The loan is disbursed: the lump-sum principal is paid out and the closed-end French-system amortization schedule is fixed at constitution (fin-math §4.1). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. | [`loans.personal_loan.LoanInstallmentPaid`](./loans.personal_loan.LoanInstallmentPaid.md) | One scheduled installment is paid: the period's interest + capital split (P(t) = J(t) + A(t), fin-math §3) and the outstanding balance after it. The amortization kernel computed the split command-side; the event records the already-computed facts. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |

A full repayment drives the balance to zero (the loan then settles). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers. | [`operations.NotificationDeliveryExhausted`](./operations.NotificationDeliveryExhausted.md) | Webhook delivery of one customer notification gave up for good: the notification service's delivery outbox retried the §D4 backoff schedule to exhaustion (10 attempts, ~12h) and dead-lettered the record — this event is the backbone announcement of that fact ([ADR-IC-011](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-011-async-saga-completion-notification.md) §D4/§P3 step 7). Produced by the NOTIFICATION service's own exhausted-event outbox ([ADR-IC-004](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-004-outbox-pattern-mechanism.md) discipline: the row is written in the SAME transaction as the DEAD_LETTERED flip), NEVER by the engine — the producing flow behind the notification is long committed and unaffected ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md) slot 5, post-flag). Consumers are operational: an operator/alerting surface picks the notification up out of band; nothing retries off this event. Cross-cutting event under the synthetic `operations` aggregate_type (event-store §4.3). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5): the CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka HEADERS, not here. NO PII — cleartext OR ciphertext ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): customer_id is an opaque recipient REFERENCE; last_error carries transport-status diagnostics only (an HTTP status line, a timeout message), never payload or subject data. |
| [`operations.NotificationDue`](./operations.NotificationDue.md) | A customer notification of template `template_ref` is due for an instance, with the structural data to render it ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md)). Engine-OWNED, engine-cross-cutting event under the synthetic `operations` aggregate_type (event-store §4.3) — the engine owns this schema and the `trigger_kind` taxonomy ([ADR-PC-025](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-025-customer-notification-emit-contract.md) §6). The engine emits only EVENT_DRIVEN + PRE_CONTRACTUAL; the enum RETAINS SCHEDULED for a DOWNSTREAM producer — the family-agnostic notification scheduler ([ADR-IC-019](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-019-family-agnostic-notification-platform.md)) reads the maturity-calendar / accrual projections and produces NotificationDue(SCHEDULED) itself, because the engine emits no clock-driven signal and runs no scheduler ([ADR-PC-023](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-023-temporal-signals-projection-derived.md)). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); the CloudEvents envelope (event_id, partition_key, valid_time/transaction_time, correlation_id) rides in Kafka HEADERS, NOT here. NO PII — cleartext OR ciphertext ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): customer_id is an opaque recipient REFERENCE the communications system resolves at render time against the engine's PII-resolve surface (returning null for a crypto-shredded subject); `data` carries STRUCTURAL interpolation values only (amounts, dates, rates, TAE), never the subject's name, NIF, or contact data. |
| [`operations.PersonalDataErasureRequested`](./operations.PersonalDataErasureRequested.md) | GDPR Article 17 right-to-be-forgotten was exercised on an instance: the subject's encryption key was crypto-shredded (IPiiKeyStore.DestroyKeyAsync, [ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P3), so all PII ciphertext under it is permanently unrecoverable; only non-personal structural fields remain queryable. A CROSS-CUTTING engine-declared event ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) Amendment A4): the same structural fact for any product family, declared once in the spine under the synthetic `operations` aggregate_type (event-store §4.3) and folded per family. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): subject_pseudonym is a salted one-way hash, NEVER the raw subject id. |
